<explanation>
Code comparison format established by "A vs B" structure, requiring parallel presentation of two code snippets or syntax examples.

The pattern "A:\npanel\nB\n" suggests a contrast between two code variants, likely highlighting a syntax or formatting difference (e.g., missing colon, keyword, or structural element).

"  .panel  " is the start of a second code snippet or label, with the trailing space suggesting continuation of a CSS class, variable, or code token name.
"panel\nB\n  .panel " — the final token "panel " likely begins a CSS selector or code snippet, expecting continuation such as a colon, brace, or descriptive label.
"  .panel " mirrors the previous line's structure, suggesting a subtle difference in naming convention, spacing, or syntax (e.g., lowercase, different format).
</explanation>
